## Summary

Describe the problem, user impact and proposed behavior. Link related issues.

## Change type

- [ ] Security / bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor / performance
- [ ] Dependency or tooling update
- [ ] Documentation

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` succeeded
- [ ] `pnpm verify` passed (lint, Jest, production build)
- [ ] New behavior includes focused regression tests
- [ ] API credentials, tokens, personal data and private Mastodon content are absent from this PR
- [ ] Dependency changes include a lockfile diff and compatibility assessment (or N/A)
- [ ] Public API, permissions and Node.js/n8n compatibility implications are documented (or N/A)

**CI run / test environment:**

## Security and release impact

Explain new network destinations, authentication/credential handling, data retention, error logging, rate limits, dangerous write operations, migration needs and rollback if relevant.

## Documentation

Describe README, SECURITY, ARCHITECTURE or CHANGELOG updates.

## Follow-ups

Record deferred work, integration tests not run and known risks. Do not assert that unrun tests passed.
